Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 68: March 2007
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #68 shipped to subscribers in February 2007 (bearing the cover date of March 2007 for Issue 68). Continuing OXM's Xbox 360-exclusive authoring, Disc #68 featured native high-definition 360 playable game demos and Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trial games:

Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon Advanced Warfighter 2 (GRAW 2) (tactical squad-based shooter)
Def Jam: Icon (hip-hop urban street brawler / fighting game)
NBA Street Homecourt (arcade-style street basketball)
Alien Hominid HD (Xbox Live Arcade side-scrolling run-and-gun)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc delivered custom dashboard media (downloadable gamerpics and themes), offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews for spring and summer 2007 blockbusters—including the iconic Halo 3 "Starry Night" trailer, previews for Command & Conquer 3: Tiberium Wars, Mass Effect, and BioShock, alongside OXM's monthly Top Plays segment.
